//go:build js && wasm

package client

import "syscall/js"

// The enum order and eight receipt fields are the frozen V3 bridge contract.
// No context, mutex, owner/cell link, callback allocation/release, or authority
// publication belongs to this adapter. The caller owns every resource first.
type offlineNativeOperation uint8
const (
 offlineNativeAppendFrame offlineNativeOperation = iota + 1
 offlineNativeParentListLive
 offlineNativeChildList
 offlineNativeChildLookup
 offlineNativeRPCActiveStatus
 offlineNativeRPCActiveDisableRecovered
 offlineNativeUpdateRegistration
 offlineNativeUnregisterRegistration
 offlineNativeRetireLive
 offlineNativeRetireUnopened
 offlineNativeRetireNeverConnected
 offlineNativeParentListRetired
)
type offlineNativeReason uint8
const (
 offlineNativeReasonNone offlineNativeReason = iota
 offlineNativeReasonEntryRefused
 offlineNativeReasonInputRefused
 offlineNativeReasonParentRefused
 offlineNativeReasonFrameRefused
 offlineNativeReasonChildRefused
 offlineNativeReasonRegistrationRefused
 offlineNativeReasonReadThrow
 offlineNativeReasonDispatchThrow
)
type offlineNativeRefs struct {
 ParentWindow, ParentDocument, ParentNavigator, ParentContainer, ParentController, ParentLocation js.Value
 Frame, Host js.Value
 ChildWindow, ChildDocument, ChildNavigator, ChildContainer, ChildController js.Value
 Candidate, Active js.Value
}
type offlineNativeNodes struct { Root, Head, Body, Waiting, Installing js.Value }
type offlineNativePolicy struct { Origin, HelperURL, WorkerURL, Scope string }
type offlineNativePayload struct {
 Version int
 Command, OwnerPolicyID, RuntimeID, ConfigurationID, RequestID string
}
type offlineNativeInput struct {
 Operation offlineNativeOperation
 Nonce string
 Refs offlineNativeRefs
 Nodes offlineNativeNodes
 Policy offlineNativePolicy
 Payload offlineNativePayload
 Port js.Value
 // This callback is already allocated and charged by the owner. Preparation
 // never calls it. Unknown dispatch/observer outcomes retain it with the cell.
 Authorize js.Func
}
type offlineNativeReceipt struct {
 Version uint8
 Nonce string
 Operation offlineNativeOperation
 Entered bool
 Reason offlineNativeReason
 Issued, Returned bool
 Value js.Value
}
type offlineNativeParent struct {
 Window, Document, Navigator, Container, Controller, Location, Root js.Value
 Origin string
}
type offlineNativeChild struct {
 Window, Document, Navigator, Container, Controller, Root, Head, Body js.Value
}
type offlineNativeChannel struct { Channel, Port1, Port2 js.Value }
type offlineNativeRegistration struct {
 Registration, Active, Waiting, Installing js.Value
 Scope, ActiveURL, WaitingURL, InstallingURL string
}

// Only this package-init claim stores production functions. There is no public
// setter or synthetic native trust path. Package tests may replace this private
// value to model refusal/decoding; such a fake never proves platform branding.
type offlineNativeCapability struct {
 valid bool
 prepare, parent, child, inspect, frame, channel, listen, remove, start, close, then js.Value
}
var offlineNativeFacet = claimOfflineNativeCapability()

func claimOfflineNativeCapability() (cap offlineNativeCapability) {
 // Modules have a separate runtime and must not consume the eager core claim.
 if moduleMode { return cap }
 defer func(){ if recover()!=nil { cap=offlineNativeCapability{} } }()
 claim:=checkedJSGet(js.Global(),"__nextgoOfflineNativeClaimV1")
 if claim.Type()!=js.TypeFunction { return cap }
 value:=checkedJSInvoke(claim)
 if value.Type()!=js.TypeObject || value.IsNull() { return cap }
 version,supported:=checkedJSGet(value,"version"),checkedJSGet(value,"supported")
 if version.Type()!=js.TypeNumber || version.Float()!=1 || supported.Type()!=js.TypeBoolean || !supported.Bool() { return cap }
 cap=offlineNativeCapability{
  prepare:checkedJSGet(value,"prepare"),parent:checkedJSGet(value,"parent"),
  child:checkedJSGet(value,"child"),inspect:checkedJSGet(value,"inspect"),frame:checkedJSGet(value,"frame"),
  channel:checkedJSGet(value,"channel"),listen:checkedJSGet(value,"listen"),remove:checkedJSGet(value,"remove"),
  start:checkedJSGet(value,"start"),close:checkedJSGet(value,"close"),then:checkedJSGet(value,"then"),
 }
 for _,f:=range []js.Value{cap.prepare,cap.parent,cap.child,cap.inspect,cap.frame,cap.channel,cap.listen,cap.remove,cap.start,cap.close,cap.then} {
  if f.Type()!=js.TypeFunction { return offlineNativeCapability{} }
 }
 cap.valid=true
 return cap
}
func offlineNativeReady() bool { return offlineNativeFacet.valid }

// Every invocation aggregate is created before Invoke, including its argument
// array holding the already-owned authorize function. Invoke imports one apply
// into the static parent-realm closure. No JS/Go scheduling gap exists between
// that closure's final native predicates and its exact native dispatch.
type offlineNativeCall struct {
 run, receipt, read, arguments, authorize js.Value
 operation offlineNativeOperation
 nonce string
 invoked bool
}
func offlineNativePrepare(input offlineNativeInput) (call *offlineNativeCall, err error) {
 if !offlineNativeFacet.valid { return nil, ErrOfflineUnsupported }
 if input.Operation<offlineNativeAppendFrame || input.Operation>offlineNativeParentListRetired || len(input.Nonce)==0 || len(input.Nonce)>128 || input.Authorize.Value.Type()!=js.TypeFunction {
  return nil,ErrOfflineUnknown
 }
 for _,text:=range []string{input.Policy.Origin,input.Policy.HelperURL,input.Policy.WorkerURL,input.Policy.Scope} {
  if len(text)==0 || len(text)>8192 {return nil,ErrOfflineUnknown}
 }
 rpc:=input.Operation==offlineNativeRPCActiveStatus || input.Operation==offlineNativeRPCActiveDisableRecovered
 if rpc {
  q:=input.Payload
  command:="status";if input.Operation==offlineNativeRPCActiveDisableRecovered {command="disable-recovered"}
  if q.Version!=1 || q.Command!=command || input.Port.Type()!=js.TypeObject || input.Port.IsNull() {return nil,ErrOfflineUnknown}
  for _,text:=range []string{q.OwnerPolicyID,q.RuntimeID,q.ConfigurationID,q.RequestID} {if len(text)==0 || len(text)>256 {return nil,ErrOfflineUnknown}}
 } else if input.Payload!=(offlineNativePayload{}) || !input.Port.IsUndefined() {return nil,ErrOfflineUnknown}
 defer func(){if recover()!=nil {call=nil;err=ErrOfflineUnknown}}()
 r,n,p:=input.Refs,input.Nodes,input.Policy
 refs:=checkedJSArray([]any{r.ParentWindow,r.ParentDocument,r.ParentNavigator,r.ParentContainer,r.ParentController,r.ParentLocation,r.Frame,r.Host,r.ChildWindow,r.ChildDocument,r.ChildNavigator,r.ChildContainer,r.ChildController,r.Candidate,r.Active})
 nodes:=checkedJSArray([]any{n.Root,n.Head,n.Body,n.Waiting,n.Installing})
 policy:=checkedJSArray([]any{p.Origin,p.HelperURL,p.WorkerURL,p.Scope})
 payload,port:=js.Undefined(),js.Undefined()
 if rpc {
  q:=input.Payload
  payload=checkedJSArray([]any{q.Version,q.Command,q.OwnerPolicyID,q.RuntimeID,q.ConfigurationID,q.RequestID})
  port=input.Port
 }
 prepared:=checkedJSInvoke(offlineNativeFacet.prepare,int(input.Operation),input.Nonce,refs,nodes,policy,payload,port)
 if prepared.Type()!=js.TypeObject || prepared.IsNull() {return nil,ErrOfflineUnknown}
 run,receipt,read:=checkedJSGet(prepared,"run"),checkedJSGet(prepared,"receipt"),checkedJSGet(prepared,"read")
 if run.Type()!=js.TypeFunction || read.Type()!=js.TypeFunction || receipt.Type()!=js.TypeObject || receipt.IsNull() {return nil,ErrOfflineUnknown}
 call=&offlineNativeCall{run:run,receipt:receipt,read:read,authorize:input.Authorize.Value,arguments:checkedJSArray([]any{input.Authorize.Value}),operation:input.Operation,nonce:input.Nonce}
 // This is a private own-data receipt before entry, not an issued operation.
 initial,e:=call.readReceipt()
 if e!=nil || initial.Entered || initial.Issued || initial.Returned || initial.Reason!=offlineNativeReasonNone {return nil,ErrOfflineUnknown}
 return call,nil
}
// ReceiptIdentity is a pure-Go reference copy for the owner's exact gate binding.
func (call *offlineNativeCall) ReceiptIdentity() js.Value {
 if call==nil {return js.Undefined()};return call.receipt
}
func (call *offlineNativeCall) Invoke(authorize js.Func) (receipt offlineNativeReceipt, err error) {
 if call==nil || call.invoked || !call.authorize.Equal(authorize.Value) {return receipt,ErrOfflineUnknown}
 call.invoked=true
 defer func(){
  if recover()!=nil {
   // Readable partial own-data flags are retained separately from this unknown
   // bridge-return error. They never turn an outer exception into a receipt.
   receipt,_=call.readReceipt();err=ErrOfflineUnknown
  }
 }()
 result:=checkedJSApply(call.run,js.Undefined(),call.arguments)
 receipt,err=call.readReceipt()
 if err!=nil || !result.Equal(call.receipt) {return receipt,ErrOfflineUnknown}
 if !receipt.Entered && receipt.Reason!=offlineNativeReasonEntryRefused {return receipt,ErrOfflineUnknown}
 if receipt.Issued && !receipt.Entered {return receipt,ErrOfflineUnknown}
 if receipt.Reason==offlineNativeReasonNone && !receipt.Returned {return receipt,ErrOfflineUnknown}
 return receipt,nil
}
func (call *offlineNativeCall) readReceipt() (receipt offlineNativeReceipt, err error) {
 defer func(){if recover()!=nil {receipt=offlineNativeReceipt{};err=ErrOfflineUnknown}}()
 // The native preparation closure checks EXACT eight own data fields and no
 // symbols, then copies them outside the protected segment. Value is the actual
 // native return/Promise, never a coerced copy or a synthetic resolved Promise.
 a:=checkedJSInvoke(call.read)
 if checkedJSLength(a)!=8 {return receipt,ErrOfflineUnknown}
 v,nonce,operation:=checkedJSIndex(a,0),checkedJSIndex(a,1),checkedJSIndex(a,2)
 entered,reason,issued,returned:=checkedJSIndex(a,3),checkedJSIndex(a,4),checkedJSIndex(a,5),checkedJSIndex(a,6)
 if v.Type()!=js.TypeNumber || v.Float()!=1 || nonce.Type()!=js.TypeString || nonce.String()!=call.nonce || operation.Type()!=js.TypeNumber || operation.Float()!=float64(call.operation) || entered.Type()!=js.TypeBoolean || reason.Type()!=js.TypeNumber || issued.Type()!=js.TypeBoolean || returned.Type()!=js.TypeBoolean {
  return receipt,ErrOfflineUnknown
 }
 number:=reason.Float()
 if number<0 || number>8 || number!=float64(uint8(number)) {return receipt,ErrOfflineUnknown}
 return offlineNativeReceipt{Version:1,Nonce:call.nonce,Operation:call.operation,Entered:entered.Bool(),Reason:offlineNativeReason(uint8(number)),Issued:issued.Bool(),Returned:returned.Bool(),Value:checkedJSIndex(a,7)},nil
}

// Preparation helpers call only startup-captured primitives. Their caller must
// precharge the corresponding realm/channel/listener before a potentially
// delivering native call. An error never asserts that allocation did not occur.
func offlineNativeCreateFrame(document js.Value, helperURL string) (frame js.Value, err error) {
 if !offlineNativeFacet.valid {return js.Undefined(),ErrOfflineUnsupported}
 if len(helperURL)==0 || len(helperURL)>8192 {return js.Undefined(),ErrOfflineUnknown}
 defer func(){if recover()!=nil {frame=js.Undefined();err=ErrOfflineUnknown}}()
 frame=checkedJSInvoke(offlineNativeFacet.frame,document,helperURL)
 if frame.Type()!=js.TypeObject || frame.IsNull() {return js.Undefined(),ErrOfflineUnknown};return frame,nil
}
func offlineNativeCaptureParent(window,document js.Value) (parent offlineNativeParent, err error) {
 if !offlineNativeFacet.valid {return parent,ErrOfflineUnsupported}
 defer func(){if recover()!=nil {parent=offlineNativeParent{};err=ErrOfflineUnknown}}()
 a:=checkedJSInvoke(offlineNativeFacet.parent,window,document)
 if checkedJSLength(a)!=8 {return parent,ErrOfflineUnknown}
 values:=[6]js.Value{}
 for i:=range values {values[i]=checkedJSIndex(a,i);if values[i].Type()!=js.TypeObject || values[i].IsNull() {return parent,ErrOfflineUnknown}}
 origin,root:=checkedJSIndex(a,6),checkedJSIndex(a,7);if origin.Type()!=js.TypeString || origin.String()=="" || root.Type()!=js.TypeObject || root.IsNull() {return parent,ErrOfflineUnknown}
 return offlineNativeParent{Window:values[0],Document:values[1],Navigator:values[2],Container:values[3],Controller:values[4],Location:values[5],Origin:origin.String(),Root:root},nil
}
func offlineNativeCaptureChild(frame js.Value) (child offlineNativeChild, err error) {
 if !offlineNativeFacet.valid {return child,ErrOfflineUnsupported}
 defer func(){if recover()!=nil {child=offlineNativeChild{};err=ErrOfflineUnknown}}()
 a:=checkedJSInvoke(offlineNativeFacet.child,frame)
 if checkedJSLength(a)!=8 {return child,ErrOfflineUnknown}
 values:=[8]js.Value{}
 for i:=range values {values[i]=checkedJSIndex(a,i);if i==4 && values[i].IsNull() {continue};if values[i].Type()!=js.TypeObject || values[i].IsNull() {return child,ErrOfflineUnknown}}
 return offlineNativeChild{Window:values[0],Document:values[1],Navigator:values[2],Container:values[3],Controller:values[4],Root:values[5],Head:values[6],Body:values[7]},nil
}
func offlineNativeInspectInventory(value js.Value) (inventory []offlineNativeRegistration, err error) {
 if !offlineNativeFacet.valid {return nil,ErrOfflineUnsupported}
 defer func(){if recover()!=nil {inventory=nil;err=ErrOfflineUnknown}}()
 a:=checkedJSInvoke(offlineNativeFacet.inspect,value)
 return offlineNativeDecodeInventory(a)
}
func offlineNativeDecodeInventory(a js.Value) (inventory []offlineNativeRegistration, err error) {
 defer func(){if recover()!=nil {inventory=nil;err=ErrOfflineUnknown}}()
 size:=checkedJSLength(a);if size>64 {return nil,ErrOfflineUnknown}
 inventory=make([]offlineNativeRegistration,size)
 for i:=range inventory {
  row:=checkedJSIndex(a,i);if checkedJSLength(row)!=8 {return nil,ErrOfflineUnknown}
  r:=offlineNativeRegistration{Registration:checkedJSIndex(row,0),Active:checkedJSIndex(row,2),Waiting:checkedJSIndex(row,3),Installing:checkedJSIndex(row,4)}
  if r.Registration.Type()!=js.TypeObject || r.Registration.IsNull() {return nil,ErrOfflineUnknown}
  fields:=[4]string{}
  for k,index:=range [4]int{1,5,6,7} {v:=checkedJSIndex(row,index);if v.Type()!=js.TypeString || len(v.String())>8192 {return nil,ErrOfflineUnknown};fields[k]=v.String()}
  r.Scope,r.ActiveURL,r.WaitingURL,r.InstallingURL=fields[0],fields[1],fields[2],fields[3]
  if r.Scope=="" {return nil,ErrOfflineUnknown}
  for k,slot:=range [3]js.Value{r.Active,r.Waiting,r.Installing} {
   url:=fields[k+1]
   if slot.IsNull() {if url!="" {return nil,ErrOfflineUnknown};continue}
   if slot.Type()!=js.TypeObject || url=="" {return nil,ErrOfflineUnknown}
  }
  inventory[i]=r
 }
 return inventory,nil
}
func offlineNativeCreateChannel() (channel offlineNativeChannel, err error) {
 if !offlineNativeFacet.valid {return channel,ErrOfflineUnsupported}
 defer func(){if recover()!=nil {channel=offlineNativeChannel{};err=ErrOfflineUnknown}}()
 a:=checkedJSInvoke(offlineNativeFacet.channel)
 if checkedJSLength(a)!=3 {return channel,ErrOfflineUnknown}
 channel=offlineNativeChannel{Channel:checkedJSIndex(a,0),Port1:checkedJSIndex(a,1),Port2:checkedJSIndex(a,2)}
 for _,v:=range []js.Value{channel.Channel,channel.Port1,channel.Port2} {if v.Type()!=js.TypeObject || v.IsNull() {return offlineNativeChannel{},ErrOfflineUnknown}}
 if channel.Port1.Equal(channel.Port2) {return offlineNativeChannel{},ErrOfflineUnknown};return channel,nil
}
func offlineNativeListen(target js.Value,event string,callback js.Func) error {
 return offlineNativeResourceCall(offlineNativeFacet.listen,target,event,callback)
}
func offlineNativeRemove(target js.Value,event string,callback js.Func) error {
 return offlineNativeResourceCall(offlineNativeFacet.remove,target,event,callback)
}
func offlineNativeStart(port js.Value) error {return offlineNativeResourceCall(offlineNativeFacet.start,port)}
func offlineNativeClose(port js.Value) error {return offlineNativeResourceCall(offlineNativeFacet.close,port)}
// Observe only after dispatch, outside protected facets. Native then can invoke
// authored constructor/species hooks; a failure keeps all handlers/cells owned.
func offlineNativePromiseThen(promise js.Value,resolved,rejected js.Func) error {
 return offlineNativeResourceCall(offlineNativeFacet.then,promise,resolved,rejected)
}
func offlineNativeResourceCall(function js.Value,args ...any) (err error) {
 if !offlineNativeFacet.valid {return ErrOfflineUnsupported}
 defer func(){if recover()!=nil {err=ErrOfflineUnknown}}()
 checkedJSInvoke(function,args...);return nil
}
